steps.title: Analyze Resource Conflict
steps.description: Inspect the build failure caused by duplicate @drawable/icon resources between icon.png and icon.xml.

steps.title: Verify App Metadata
steps.description: Verify that app-meta.json maintains the exact app name and package name for Popeen Voice Assistant.

steps.title: Clean Duplicate Icon Resources
steps.description: Remove the conflicting icon.xml vector resource to ensure only the required PNG icon at app/src/main/res/drawable/icon.png is merged.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Icon References
steps.description: Ensure AndroidManifest.xml correctly references @drawable/icon for android:icon and android:roundIcon.

steps.title: Verify Build Configuration
steps.description: Ensure app/build.gradle and root build.gradle configurations are compatible with Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Validate Voice Assistant Service & Components
steps.description: Check VoiceAssistantService, BootReceiver, and PreferencesHelper to ensure intact voice recognition logic.

steps.title: Verify UI Layout and Resources
steps.description: Confirm activity_main.xml and XML resource files render properly without resource collisions.

steps.title: Validate Resource Merge Process
steps.description: Ensure all drawables, colors, strings, and layout resources merge cleanly without duplicates during packaging.

steps.title: Execute Pre-Build Checks
steps.description: Confirm Java 8 compatibility and syntax across all source files in com.popeen.app.

steps.title: Building Popeen Voice Assistant
steps.description: Assemble and build the debug APK for Popeen Voice Assistant using Gradle.
